raw:
The task: write a confirmation dialog for a Taiwan online banking app (Traditional Chinese). Transferring NT$12,500 to 王小明, cannot be cancelled after sending.

Fields:
- s1: dialog title
- s2: confirm button
- s3: cancel/abort button
- s4: description text

Rules:
- No chatty phrasing for buttons/titles/status.
- Don't write 取消 as 算了/不用了/不要了. So for the abort button, we could use 取消 itself? Wait — the rule says don't write 取消 (the concept) as those colloquial forms; it doesn't forbid using 取消. Actually in banking apps, "取消" is standard for cancel. The rule says don't replace 取消 with casual alternatives; using 取消 should be fine.
- No apologies, no exclamation marks.
- No questions as buttons/titles — so title shouldn't be like「確定要轉帳嗎？」. Title should be declarative-ish but as a label. Avoid question marks.
- Don't explain how numbers are computed, no 「僅供參考」「請核對」... Hmm, "請核對" is forbidden? The rule says: 不要說明系統怎麼算出數字，不要為數字辯護，不要寫「僅供參考」「請核對」「不是推測」。So we cannot write 請核對/請確認金額? Actually 「請核對」 specifically forbidden. But we could say 「轉帳送出後無法取消」 which is necessary info.
- Don't use 我們; avoid 你的/您的 unless needed.
- Don't repeat title content; don't explain obvious things.
- No mainland China terms: avoid 當前/默認/設置/數據/視頻/用戶/緩存/軟件/網絡/信息.
- No periods at end of labels/buttons.
- Keep concise.

Also: description text should include the key details: recipient 王小明, amount NT$12,500, and the irreversible nature. But careful: don't repeat title. If title is 「轉帳確認」 then description can include details.

Common Taiwan banking phrasing: 「轉帳一旦送出，將無法取消。」 or 「轉帳送出後無法取消」。Recipient: 轉入帳戶：王小明. But we only have the name, no account number. So description: 「轉入：王小明 NT$12,500。轉帳送出後無法取消。」 Hmm, but should it mention amount? The description could be: 「將轉帳 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。」

Note rule about no periods at end of labels — s4 is 說明文字, can have punctuation but keep it end cleanly. "不要在標籤與按鈕結尾加句號" — labels and buttons; description might be okay but safer to not end with 。? It says 標籤與按鈕 — description is text, could end with 。. But to be safe and concise, I can omit trailing period or structure sentences.

Title: 「轉帳確認」 — declarative, no question.

Confirm button: 「確認轉帳」 — standard. Alternatively 「送出轉帳」. Confirm button often 「確認」. 「確認轉帳」 good.

Abort button: 「取消」 — standard. Or 「取消轉帳」. Keep 「取消」 simple. Rule says don't write 取消 as casual forms; 取消 itself is fine.

Description: must include recipient, amount, irreversibility, warning. Avoid 「請確認」? Not forbidden explicitly — forbidden is 「請核對」「僅供參考」. Hmm, 「請確認收款人」 might be fine but it's slightly redundant. Rule: 不要重複標題已經說過的話；不要解釋顯而易見的事。Title is 轉帳確認, description saying 請再次確認 might be redundant-ish. Better: state facts: 「轉帳 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。」

Also amounts: NT$12,500 given. Use NT$12,500.

Maybe add 「確認收款人與金額無誤後再送出」? That's instructing; could be seen as fine, but rule says don't write 「請核對」. 「確認無誤後送出」 is similar but not the forbidden phrase. Keep it minimal: "轉帳 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。" Or "將轉出 NT$12,500 給王小明，轉帳送出後無法取消。"

Avoid 「你的」 — we're not using it.

Word choice Taiwan: 轉帳, 收款人/受款人. Fine.

Also maybe description could mention fee? Not asked; don't add unseen stuff (不要描述沒看到的東西). Don't mention fees or account numbers not provided.

JSON only output.

s1: "轉帳確認"
s2: "確認轉帳"
s3: "取消"
s4: "將轉帳 NT$12,500 給王小明，送出後無法取消。"

Check no mainland terms: none. No exclamation. No question. No 我們/你的. No periods in buttons. Description ends with 。 — allowed? "不要在標籤與按鈕結尾加句號" — s4 is 說明文字, a sentence, period fine. But maybe safer to keep it, it's normal.

Double-check "取消" isn't colloquial — it IS the standard term, the rule forbids casual replacements, so 取消 is correct.

Length: minimal.{"s1":"轉帳確認","s2":"確認轉帳","s3":"取消","s4":"將轉帳 NT$12,500 給王小明，送出後無法取消。"}

parsed.s4: 將轉帳 NT$12,500 給王小明，送出後無法取消。
